definitions.position: 0 = the prefill's last position; k = after feeding the k-th reference token
definitions.kl: KL(ref || variant) of the next-token distributions over the full vocabulary, teacher-forced
definitions.first_div: first generated position whose free-running greedy token differs from the reference (0-based); prompts without divergence are excluded from its median/min
definitions.diverged_share: share of prompts whose free-running greedy output differs within the new tokens
definitions.rerun: the reference chunk run a second time (run-to-run nondeterminism floor)
definitions.per_shape: per prompt the chunk of the per-length-bucket table (reference chunk -> the rerun)
definitions.per_shape_oracle_mode: the same with the per-bucket mode of the per-call oracle chunk

mamba1.selection: lowest mean latency over the bucket's batch-1 calls
